summary.intent: Evaluate how well the wisp plugins support front-end work and design ideation by analyzing past orin-dx and pages sessions, then act on the findings by redesigning the plugin set for v5 (a core wisp plugin, packs, deleted old plugins) while keeping Codex and Antigravity support.
summary.outcome: Four investigations found the spec-gated plugin workflows too rigid for exploratory design work, with no visual or ideation capability. Following that, the wisp core, plugin deletion with muse/courier trims, and a release-script resume fix were merged on local branch v5-core with just check passing; wisp-packs is still running and nothing is pushed.

repo: Plugin set was a spec-driven lifecycle (weaver, vanguard, scribe/muse, navigator, smith, courier) with typed JSON handoffs in shared/schemas and default-fail gates; no plugin has browser, screenshot, visual or generative capability.
muse docs reference a ranger accessibility taxonomy that was never implemented, so implemented a11y was never checked.
spec@1 has no fields for tokens, layout, breakpoints or visuals, so specs can pass the gate while saying nothing about appearance.
Schemas are byte-immutable and a commit guard blocks deleting tracked ones, so orphan schemas like codex-adaptation@1.json stay.
Codex files under .agents/plugins and dist/codex are generated by just marketplace-sync and must not be hand-edited; Codex has a description budget (7907 of 8000 after adding wisp).
just check stops at the first failing recipe, so recipes must be run individually to see all failures.
Only 2 real top-level sessions exist in the orin-dx project dir and about 7 in pages; the other hundreds of jsonl files are subagent transcripts.
orin-dx-site has no git or docs, only brand artifacts; all docs live in ~/projects/pages/docs.
Entire integration files (.codex/hooks.json, .cursor, .gemini, .opencode) reference the authoring hook and are left alone.

code.finding: ROUTES now only routes wisp:verifier (and previously muse:exit-gate) to verdict@3; tests require an agent file for every route, so deleting agents requires pruning routes.
New Stop hook blocks once asking for a 'Not verified:' line; fails open, uses stop_hook_active to avoid loops, per-session fingerprint, WISP_STOP_CHECK=off disables. Untested in a live session.
Release now resumes after a partial tag push: creates missing local tags, pushes missing remote tags, creates GitHub release only if none exists.

workflow: Gate loops became fix-and-resubmit churn on wording; the orchestrator ignored the 3-retry escalation cap and continued without asking the user.
Specs were not judgeable by the user without rendered visuals; ideation worked when options were shown as rendered boards and the user answered with short codes.
Subagent work in parallel worktrees merges with conflicts in generated files; resolve by taking one side then regenerating.
Do not choose defaults on scope questions (e.g. removing Codex/AGY) without asking; the user corrected this.
Cross-session design decisions get lost without a persistent decision log.

friction: Orchestrator removed Codex and Antigravity support on its own default and the user had to correct it, wasting a track's work.
The permission classifier denied the housekeeping track (remote branch deletes, resolving Entire findings) without saying which action triggered it.
Large 60-130KB spec and plan files stalled agents; 17 failed agent tasks and many stall mentions.
Specs lagged prototypes and visual defects (NavSheet not full screen, wrong breakpoints) were caught only by the user's eye after gates passed.
Redirecting running tracks via message may not reach agents already mid-work.
Test suite failed during integration on stale muse:component references and handback routes to deleted agents.
open_items: Merge the wisp-packs track into v5-core, then push and open the PR.

Prune the NO_CALLER_YET allowlist of eight unused shared references.

Confirm Entire opened the PR for the Caliper trail 413; Pages draft PR 44 is open.
Verify wisp Stop hook and new skills in live Claude Code and Codex; only unit-tested so far.
Add wisp and wisp-packs links and Codex/AGY install lines to root README; shared/constitution.md still describes superseded cognitive-mode separation.
Decide on discarded removal branch worktree-agent-a6c9da08625c26c4d (not deleted).
Future work: wisp CLI, wisp-packs catalog location and naming, unresolved orin-dx-site brand source of truth, TokenEconomizer trial.
